The chip entry method feels natural, and clicking a tag to filter the collection is exactly what I want. Lowercasing and replacing spaces with hyphens is welcome, and the same normalised tag shouldn’t be added twice to one bookmark.

I do want suggestions from my existing tags as I type, so I can select one instead of accidentally creating a near-duplicate. Also, the stated normalising would still make `MachineLearning` and `machine learning` into different tags (`machinelearning` and `machine-learning`), so autocomplete is important rather than assuming those forms are automatically equivalent. With that addition, the tag flow looks right.
